_about: The one source of Accretion's look. scripts/design_tokens.py writes the colour block at the top of site/style.css and the app's AccretionTokens.swift from this file. Edit here, then run: python scripts/design_tokens.py --app ../accretion-app
_colors: Text colours read at 4.5:1 or more on bg, surface and raised (and on a 14% tint of themselves) in both themes. accent and accent-2 are for fills, borders and marks; text uses accent-text and link. accent-fill/-end sit under on-accent, rose-fill under on-accent, avatar-ink on the avatar colours. line is a decorative hairline; line-strong (3:1) edges inputs.

fonts.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
